result.instructions: Tools for WordPress, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my posts are still drafts, and when were they last edited?"; "Create a draft post titled 'Q4 release notes' with a short summary, and leave it unpublished."; "Show the comments waiting for approval on the pricing page and mark the spam ones as spam.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WordPress data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wordpress_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wordpress_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wordpress_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wordpress_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wordpress_get_site
tools.title: Get site information
tools.description: Get the site name, description, URL, time zone and the REST namespaces the site offers. Good first call to check the connection. WordPress API: GET /wp-json/.

tools.name: wordpress_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the logged-in user
tools.description: Get the WordPress user that the Application Password belongs to, with its roles. WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/users/me.

tools.name: wordpress_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List posts with their status, dates, author, categories and tags. Use status 'draft' or 'pending' for unpublished work (needs edit rights). WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/posts.

search.description: Only items whose text matches this search string.

status.description: Post status filter (default publish). Non-public statuses need edit rights.

author.description: Only posts by these author ids.

categories.description: Only posts in these category ids.

tags.description: Only posts with these tag ids.

after.description: Only posts published after this date-time.

before.description: Only posts published before this date-time.

modified_after.description: Only posts modified after this date-time.

tools.name: wordpress_get_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Get one post with its full content, excerpt, categories and tags. Use context 'edit' to read the raw content before an update. WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/posts/{id}.

post_id.description: The WordPress id (from a list tool).

context.description: view (default) returns rendered content; edit returns the raw content for editing (needs edit rights).

tools.name: wordpress_list_pages
tools.title: List pages
tools.description: List pages with their status, parent, menu order and link. WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/pages.

search.description: Only items whose text matches this search string.

parent.description: Only child pages of these page ids.

tools.name: wordpress_get_page
tools.title: Get a page
tools.description: Get one page with its full content and parent. Use context 'edit' to read the raw content. WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/pages/{id}.

page_id.description: The WordPress id (from a list tool).

context.description: view (default) returns rendered content; edit returns the raw content for editing (needs edit rights).

tools.name: wordpress_list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List comments, optionally for one post and by moderation status (approve, hold = waiting, spam, trash). WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/comments.

post_id.description: Only comments on this post id.

search.description: Only items whose text matches this search string.

tools.name: wordpress_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List site users (name, slug, roles where the login may see them). Needs the list_users capability. WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/users.

search.description: Only items whose text matches this search string.

roles.description: Only users with these roles, for example editor.

tools.name: wordpress_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List post categories with their id, slug, parent and post count. WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/categories.

search.description: Only items whose text matches this search string.

parent.description: Only child categories of this category id.

tools.name: wordpress_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List post tags with their id, slug and post count. WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/tags.

search.description: Only items whose text matches this search string.

tools.name: wordpress_list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: List media library items (images, files) with their URL, MIME type and alt text. WordPress API: GET /wp/v2/media.

search.description: Only items whose text matches this search string.

mime_type.description: Exact MIME type, for example image/jpeg.

tools.name: wordpress_create_draft_post
tools.title: Create a draft post
tools.description: Create a new post saved as a DRAFT (never published). Writes to the site. WordPress API: POST /wp/v2/posts with status draft.

content.description: The post body (HTML or block markup).

tools.name: wordpress_update_post
tools.title: Update a post
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on an existing post, overwriting them. If the post is already published, the new content goes live at once. The status may be draft, pending or private only; publishing a draft stays in wp-admin. WordPress API: POST /wp/v2/posts/{id}.

post_id.description: The WordPress id (from a list tool).

tools.name: wordpress_set_comment_status
tools.title: Moderate a comment
tools.description: Set a comment's moderation status: approve, hold (wait for review) or spam. Comments are never trashed or deleted by this tool. WordPress API: POST /wp/v2/comments/{id}.
